name: University of Michigan
summary: Public research university in Ann Arbor, Michigan.
body:
Public university ([OBP report card](https://obp.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/pubdata/mandatoryreports/Section_241_Report_Card_2025-26.pdf)). 53,488 students on the Ann Arbor campus, fall 2025 headcount ([enrollment report](https://obp.umich.edu/wp-content/uploads/pubdata/factsfigures/enrollment_umsystem_2025.pdf)).

Michigan Robotics, the Department of Robotics in the College of Engineering, was founded in 2022 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Michigan_Department_of_Robotics)) and is housed in the Ford Motor Company Robotics Building on North Campus ([Michigan Robotics](https://robotics.umich.edu/?p=6029)).
